content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_types_compare simple case: plots two ship-wake surface-elevation snapshots (eta_00005 and eta_00010) as stacked pcolor panels. Same template as vessel_flat_bottom/plot_wave_vessel.m with different values: output directory ../output/ (L2), sizing load eta_00001 (L4, L6), x,y with dx=dy=1.0 (L7-L10), snapshots nfile=[5 10] with labels min={'5' '10'} (L12-L13), 5x8-inch figure (L15-L18). Per snapshot (L21-L40): loads eta_<fnum> (L23-L24), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading in subplot(length(nfile),1,num) (L26-L28), fixes caxis [-2.5 2.5] (L30), titles ' Time = <min> sec ' (L31), labels y/x (L33, L35), forces zbuffer (L38). Stale commented export at L41.
